title: Neatness
summary: NEATNESS, noun 1. Exact cleanliness; entire freedom from foul matter; as the neatness of a floor or of a garment. 2. Purity; freedom from ill chosen words; as the neatness of style. 3. Freedom from us

inlines.v: NEATNESS, noun 1. Exact cleanliness; entire freedom from foul matter; as the neatness of a floor or of a garment. 2. Purity; freedom from ill chosen words; as the neatness of style. 3. Freedom from useless or tawdry ornaments; with good adjustment of the several parts; as the neatness of a dress.
